mapper.select: SELECT PROFILE_PATH, PROFILE_RENAME FROM PROFILE_IMG WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CODE, TO_CHAR(BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BOARD_WRITE_DATE FROM BOARD WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND BOARD_CODE != 5 AND BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_NO NOT IN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM PENALTY WHERE PENALTY_TYPE = 'PERMANENT' AND PENALTY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) AND ROWNUM <= 10
